summary: Preview data disk capacity and retry invalid setup paths with bounded Bitcoin reuse accounting
details: First setup displays default-directory filesystem capacity and free space before prompting, and keeps requesting a directory when capacity or path checks fail. There is no admission bypass; EOF or interruption cancels before configuration is written.

Compatible retained Bitcoin blocks and chainstate on the selected filesystem reduce the free-space requirement from 1.5 TiB, with a 512 GiB rebuild floor. Count allocated regular-file bytes only; exclude optional indexes, logs, wallets, raw snapshots, links and other filesystems. Unknown or unreadable data receives no allowance.

The total-capacity minimum remains 1.5 TiB. Optional Ord adds 300 GiB to both total-capacity and adjusted free-space requirements and can trigger directory reselection. Configure rechecks before creating node configuration and data directories.
Document capacity calculations and retained-data reinstall behavior, and include the accounting helper in immutable release kits.
operator_actions: Install a node kit containing this change. To reuse Bitcoin after uninstall --purge-data --keep-bitcoin, select the original Host data root during setup and review the measured capacity and allowance.
